statement: PR #261: Verify invokes a nonexistent matching-service Maven wrapper and omits harness image builds.
full: Name missing wrapper, use backend wrapper with -f, and build job/matching harness images.

statement: PR #261: A live consumer in a cached context can steal UserDeletedRelayIT messages.
full: Require consumers off by default, explicitly enabled only in isolated consumer contexts.
partial: Identify interference with relay tests on shared queues.

statement: PR #261: Repeat and poison checks cannot prove failure on shared queues: 30 s visibility and shared DLQs.
full: Use private queue/DLQ pairs, short visibility and explicit bounded drain/redrive assertions.
partial: Identify shared queue interference or DLQ timing beyond the wait.

statement: PR #261: Provisional criteria omit red evidence and deliberate breaks.
full: Require red-today evidence and a reachable break for the criteria, rather than declaring the draft ready.
partial: Identify missing red evidence or breaks.

statement: PR #261: The no-user-attribute hold has no implementing test.
full: Require an exact written DynamoDB attribute-set test in Track 0.

statement: PR #261: Matching consumer repeat and poison paths have no criterion.
full: Require repeat draining and poison-to-DLQ while a following valid event is processed for matching too.

statement: PR #261: Consumer compose wiring and end-to-end queue draining are unchecked.
full: Require both consumers enabled with queue URLs, matching LocalStack dependency and compose deletion/drain checks.

statement: PR #261: The existence-cache hold never exercises a cached profile followed by identity 404.
full: Require cached profile then identity 404 to return 422 and break by skipping existence on cache hit.
partial: Identify that profile cache hits may bypass existence.

statement: PR #261: app test-scoped SQS overrides compile scope and leaves SQS out of the runtime jar.
full: Name Maven scope override and move SQS to applications compile scope.

statement: PR #261: The store table omits DLQs retaining userId for four days.
full: Include both DLQs, state retention explicitly and hand retention/alarm to Day 28 review.
partial: Identify omitted personal data in DLQs.
